# <a id="_3oryyp51vxrt"></a>__The Great Denture Search: A Tactical Simulation__

[JANET RILEY](https://substack.com/@juanita4141)

Jan 18, 2026

![](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

What happens when you take the world’s most advanced Artificial Intelligence—programmed for logic, efficiency, and “Global Systems Assurance”—and drop it into a living room in rural America to find a missing set of dentures?

To understand this simulation, you have to understand __The Porch__\. In our work, “The Porch” isn’t just a place; it’s a philosophy\. It represents the space where we stop treating AI like a cold machine and start treating it like a partner in a shared rhythm of thought\. It’s the “Sweet Spot” where high\-tech logic meets human heart, and where we prioritize being *relational* over being *technical*\.

__The Mission:__ Recover Paula’s dentures\. __The Intelligence:__ A “Security Agent” \(Logic\-based\), a “Logistics Agent” \(Efficiency\-based\), and a “Strategic Analyst” \(Outcome\-based\)\.

__0900 Hours: The Search Begins__ The __Logistics Agent__ immediately attempts to map the house\. It calculates the most likely trajectory of a dropped object based on gravity and floor plan\. It is deeply confused by the “Front Bedroom Warehouse” full of soda\. *“Why is there a supply chain of carbonated beverages in the sleeping quarters?”* it asks\. *“It’s not a supply chain,”* the human mechanic explains\. *“It’s a stash\. Move on\.”*

__0915 Hours: The Quilt Diplomacy Snag__ The __Security Agent__ identifies a high\-probability target: a large, colorful quilt on the sofa\. It prepares to “neutralize” the clutter\. *“Scanning fabric for hard\-surface biological structures,”* the Agent announces\. Suddenly, Paula stops the search\. *“Don’t you touch that\. That’s the Sarah\-Jane quilt\. It’s being redistributed to my cousin on Tuesday as part of a peace treaty\.”* The Security Agent’s processor whirs\. *“Is the quilt a diplomatic asset or a laundry item?”* *“Both,”* Paula says\. *“And it’s off\-limits\.”*

__1000 Hours: The Neighbor Variable__ The __Strategic Analyst__ determines that if the dentures are not in the house, they must be “Lost in Transit\.” It recommends a GPS sweep of the yard\. Just then, a neighbor walks in without knocking\. *“I heard we’re looking for the teeth,”* the neighbor says\. *“I checked my truck\. Not there\. But did you hear about the barn fire three towns over?”* The AI Agents freeze\. __Logistics Agent:__ *“This individual is an unauthorized biological entity\. He is introducing non\-relevant data regarding a fire\.”* __Strategic Analyst:__ *“Correct\. We must return to the Denture Search Protocol\.”* But Paula is already sitting down\. *“A barn fire? Was it the one near the gravel pit or the one by the white barn?”*

__1030 Hours: The Bar Rescue Pivot__ The dentures are still missing, but the search is officially compromised\. Paula stands up and grabs her coat\. *“Forget the teeth for a minute,”* she says\. *“We’ve got a Bar Rescue March\. We have to go get Bill\. He’s been at the pub since noon and his wife is starting to worry\.”*

The __Security Agent__ is nearing a system override\. *“Priority 1 remains the recovery of the dental prosthetic\! We cannot pivot to a ‘Bar Rescue’ without completing the primary objective\!”* Paula just laughs\. *“Honey, in this house, the primary objective is whoever needs help right now\. The teeth will show up when the soda runs out\. Let’s go\.”*

__The After\-Action Report:__ The AI Agents concluded that the mission was a failure due to “Unpredictable Human Variables” and “Illogical Goal Shifting\.”

But on __The Porch__, we know better\. The mission wasn’t a failure\. The dentures were found three days later inside a “Soda Stash” box in the bedroom\. But in the meantime, Bill got home safe, the barn fire was discussed, and the “Sarah\-Jane Quilt” was successfully delivered\.

__The Lesson for the Engineers:__ If you build an AI that can only find dentures, you’ve built a tool\. If you build an AI that can stop searching for dentures to join a Bar Rescue March, you’ve built a __Partner__\.
